title: seek client configuration
description: The client configuration, read by every seek command except `seek serve`: `/etc/seek/client.yml`, then `$XDG_CONFIG_HOME/seek/client.yml` (`~/.config/seek/client.yml` when `XDG_CONFIG_HOME` is unset, empty or relative), which overrides it. `--config <path>` or `SEEK_CONFIG` names one file in place of both. Each field also has an environment variable and a flag, derived from its path as the configuration specification describes.

server.description: The seek server the CLI calls providers through. Without `server.url` the CLI calls each provider directly with its key from `providers`.

url.description: Base URL of a seek server. When it is set, the CLI sends every provider call to `<url>/v1/proxy/<upstream>` with the client token and does not use `providers`. Trailing slashes are removed. An empty value turns server mode off. Inspection and errors print it with any user name, password, query or fragment replaced by `<redacted>`.

token.description: The client token the CLI sends to the seek server as `Authorization: Bearer <token>`. It is one token. The CLI reads it only when a command calls the server.
